neighbours.label: The word giving the dimension or basis of a stated quantity ('inches in length', 'tall', 'year on year', 'YoY'); the same subjects with no quantity stay quiet.
fire: These fish are two to four inches in length.
The horse is 15 hands tall at the shoulder.
Sales rose 3.2% year on year in May.
Traffic is up 80% YoY for the app.
The table is six feet in width.
The snakes grow to about a meter in length.
Exports fell 2% year over year in June.
quiet: These fish are native to the northern lakes.
The horse is calm and likes apples.
Traffic is up for the app.
The table is made of oak.
The snakes live under rocks in the desert.

notes: Probes: 0.40-1.02. 'Profuse bleeding' read 0.005, so the card's bleeding and blood examples remain unexplained and are not covered.
